456:t_027:17.en:
$$ミコノ$$
($$アポロ$$... He's looking at me...)

456:t_028:0.en:
$$レズン$$
「Damn it...! If we keep this up, $$ジオン$$ will only lose ground!」

456:t_028:2.en:
$$レズン$$
「Shut up! You abandoned $$ジオン$$ to chase your ideals! What the hell can you do for us now?!」

456:t_028:3.en:
$$レズン$$
「Neither I nor $$ギュネイ$$ will forgive you! Don't forget that!」

456:t_029:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「I was prepared for this. There's no need to worry, $$カミーユ$$.」

456:t_029:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「I know. Even if I have cast aside the name $$赤い彗星$$, it is my duty to save them.」

456:t_100:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Earth's great! Getting to fight monsters like this is the best!」

456:t_100:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「A Wingless with no manners. Little wonder you fail to recognize your own sin.」

456:t_100:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I'm used to people talking like I'm less than human. It's not much fun, though.」

456:t_100:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「No one can stop me...! I am $$欲深な金牛$$, $$エルーナルーナ・バーンストラウス$$!」

456:t_100:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I lead $$ハイアデス$$, the galaxy's strongest fighting force! You're taking me on, Shadow Angel!」

456:t_100:6.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh... You people... may be more useful than I thought.」

456:t_101:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! Today, I'm finally going to stop you!」

456:t_101:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Then shall I stop your breathing instead?」

456:t_101:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「No... Killing both of you would be boring. I'll let one of you live.」

456:t_101:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Losing your life, or living out your remaining years alone... I'll let you choose for yourselves.」

456:t_101:6.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「We won't be swallowed up by your hatred...!」

456:t_101:8.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Enough talk. It's time to bring down the curtain on your lives.」

456:t_102:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Two women and one man... The roots I patiently spread have sprouted, bloomed, and are about to bear fruit.」

456:t_102:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Your ambitions end here, $$ミカゲ$$! For $$シェリル$$ and the others, I'll defeat you right here!」

456:t_102:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That single-minded devotion gives me strength...」

456:t_103:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Hi, darling! How've you been?!」

456:t_103:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「I figured out why you wear me out. You... act just like $$メール$$.」

456:t_103:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Then maybe I could get along with her too!」

456:t_103:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「OK, I've got it! I'll take care of her too, so both of you should join $$ハイアデス$$!」

456:t_103:7.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Taking care of two people is a breeze for someone as bighearted as $$エルーナルーナ$$! So come on over without a worry!」

456:t_103:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「That's another thing you have in common! You just go with the flow without any principles! You can't get by on that alone!」

456:t_104:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「So that's the famous $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$! It's pretty nice!」

456:t_104:1.en:
$n
「You have time to compliment the machine that's going to beat you?」

456:t_104:2.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I do. You've gotten stronger, but you've still got a long way to go as far as I'm concerned.」

456:t_104:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I'll coach you right now! Then you'll get much, much stronger!」

456:t_104:4.en:
$n
「No thanks! There's only one woman I want to call my teacher!」

456:t_105:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「I've found some big prey! I'll take it down!」

456:t_105:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「A serious battle with the legendary Mechanical Angel! This should be fun!」

456:t_105:2.en:
$$シリウス$$
「This woman...! She's like a raging bull that doesn't know how to back down!」

456:t_105:3.en:
$$アポロ$$
「$$シルヴィア$$ has given me plenty of practice handling women like that!」

456:t_105:4.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Hey, $$アポロ$$! Don't lump me in with someone like her!」

456:t_105:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「You can nag me later! This one's gonna be a real mouthful!」

456:t_105:6.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Here I come, $$エルーナルーナ$$! I'll turn your precious machine into steak and eat it!」

456:t_106:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Hehe... $$アクエリオン$$... It's been 12,000 years.」

456:t_106:1.en:
$$シリウス$$
「I never imagined we would fight alongside $$アクエリオン$$ again.」

456:t_106:2.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Oh, Brother. I always thought this day would come.」

456:t_106:3.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「I believed the day would come when I'd see you and $$アポロ$$ again.」

456:t_106:6.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「Come on, $$アポロ$$! The enemy's right in front of us!」

456:t_106:7.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Yeah! With you fighting beside me, I can't see us losing!」

456:t_106:8.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Let's go! The sun has risen again!!」

456:t_107:0.en:
$$レズン$$
「I'm going to make you answer for what you've done, Colonel $$シャア$$!」

456:t_107:1.en:
$$シャア$$
(If I cannot face this, I will never defeat $$フル・フロンタル$$ or $$ハマーン$$...!)

456:t_107:2.en:
